name: Mask of the Green Lord
entries: A verdant, leaf-traced mask said to bear the regard of the Green Lord. It carries the same predatory presence as a Mask of the Urdefolcin, layered with quiet, watchful sight.
While wearing the mask, you can transform into an urdefolcin at will. While transformed, you use the urdefolcin's stat block in place of your own game statistics.

If your hit points are reduced to 0 while you are transformed into an urdefolcin, you immediately revert to your original form. After reverting in this way, you cannot transform into an urdefolcin with the mask again until you finish a long rest.

While wearing the mask, you continuously perceive magical effects and auras as if you were concentrating on the Detect Magic spell. This sense requires no concentration and cannot be ended by damage or other interruption while the mask is worn.

While wearing the mask, when you look upon a Tide Pool of Divination of the kind used by the Malthrenok of the Magarisok, you clearly perceive the safest path through it. You see only the safest route currently available; the mask does not reveal the pool's other visions or hidden meanings.
